description:
What lets you hand the platform to an agent, and where to check it rather than take our word: who the caller is (awiam), what an admitted agent may do and spend (awpermit), and how a service with no public address is reached (awtunnel). The public page is https://aitherium.com/trust/ -- DNSSEC, TLS, HSTS, OIDC, auth.md, the vault, tenant scoping, the tunnel, the mesh, the agent-readiness scan and the honest list of third parties, each linked to live evidence and re-verified by a checker every four hours.

Includes: awiam, awpermit, awtunnel
